info.title: Claude Console (Managed Agents, experimental)
info.description: Managed Agents in the Anthropic Claude Console: deployments, agents, environments, vaults, runs, sessions, memory stores and skills. Uses your signed-in browser session.

history.note: Managed Agents read operations and an identity read, learned from a recording.
Console header parameters and optional beta/limit queries.
18 Managed Agents read operations; workspace identity read.

Writes: create environment, vault, agent and deployment; update and run deployments; archive vault credentials. Creating vault credentials is excluded by design (secret fields never pass through Blink).
Public bundled edition: workspace, organization and Console header values are your own private variables; beta=true is the default.

workspaceId.description: Your Console workspace ID, from the private Blink

organizationUuid.description: Your Console organization UUID, from the private Blink

anthropicVersion.description: The anthropic-version header your Console session sends

anthropicBeta.description: The anthropic-beta header your Console session sends

clientPlatform.description: The anthropic-client-platform header your Console session sends

directBrowserAccess.description: The anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access header your Console session sends

get.x-blink-notes: Identity read for binding. Limitation: it confirms access to your workspace vault, not which person is signed in, so another Console user with the same workspace would also pass. Before writes, record a current-user read with Blink (blink_start_recording on platform.claude.com) and bind to it.
